data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Google's ML Kit Face Mesh Detection to generate 3D face meshes.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that uses Google's ML Kit to generate real-time high-accuracy 3D face meshes with 468 points from selfie-like images. It acts as a bridge to native platform APIs via platform channels.
use_when: You need to build augmented reality or face filtering features requiring a dense 3D face mesh.
You are processing selfie-like images where faces are within ~2 meters of the camera.
avoid_when: You need face detection for subjects further than 2 meters away from the camera.
You are targeting web or platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Provides high-accuracy 3D face meshes of 468 points.
Asynchronous processing via platform channels keeps the UI responsive.
weaknesses: Feature is still in Beta and faces some platform limitations (e.g., iOS support status notes).
No processing is done in Dart; it depends entirely on native Google ML Kit implementations.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android minSdkVersion 21, compile/targetSdkVersion 36. For iOS apps using Swift Package Manager, the deployment target must be at least 15.0.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_text_recognition
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this alternative if you need optical character recognition instead of face mesh detection.
